book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: 1 KORIN Pol ok mega namua Korin nagirewa inamup sen

content: Moni bongamen yan tan God waenapan mega munane
Endi moni bongame yan ta God waenapan mega wat agoat mumapen menan wain. Ian at Galesia nagirewa wadiamona tane ap umap tan.

Wam pura bawarewa gapan gapan moni ega baware o kamontu e nao gapan wariana omewa semua gapan, e daiton daiton siwanian. Moni ame watu doriwanian, ame ne tauapena wamewa gapan ne moni sia bongamepen menan sia ya wain, iwa om ineta.
Tauapena, e orup da da om enumoyana aro munapen menan ne ok ame se munain. Ap ogewa amba yan aiman ega, moni ame, tambu Ierusalem watu enamoin.
Wam ame gapan den anget anupena tautananek amoin.
Pol pa tau ge tau aepi noa
Ne imuna upan sean at Masedonia angepen taivin, menan at ame taua garawat angepena amba daio inayap ongain.
Anse ne ongepena amena wam konintu tanae waingain o aunari wamewa den tanae waingain. Amba at da ugup sia angepena wat agoat nimanegai.
Ne mondi ayogo ya yawaet anuivin go wam nonongantuk amena den tanae waniget anuivin, ame God wapi gapan.
Endi ne mapa pa Epesas gapan waingain, Pentikos barip wamewa uon tapi amba angain.

Iwa God menan nao kanama mapa wandia, waenapan aruga God nop mega anut anuiwanum ap menan wadidiamot anuivin. Tandayat nimanegine nagire aruga den mapa wanumam, go dim da uon, God nao mega di taingain.
Apan Timoti inayap tauepiwa, e waupan evenan tan iwa ne Keriso menan taina ap mini me den taiwan.
Orup da me inap tanda ya wap go wat agoasen watu enane, nonup gapan entane inana tauep. Me Iesu anu tumasine nagirewa upi den tanam inanap tauapen menan nambenamu taivin.
Amba evenanu apan Apolos dadak kaimakaet wanan evenan wainu upi tanam inaya onapen, go me da endi ona ona umap uon, go me wam arok kakae da warepi me oneta.
Pol gaun mega uiwa
Waniene yama taiwanian, imuya anu dawan gapan kaimakaet amu yonan. Tap ya anune go aroe den waniwanian.
Ap menan dim dim taiwaniampina, imuya waenapan munan anu gurane gapan taiwanian.
E Stepanas, pa mega nagirewa den, asigiap, mu at Guris gapan Iesu oit mega namu anune gapan anu tumasen. Endi mu God waenapan mega wat agoat mumapen men usenagaet taiwanum.
Tatan gwanin, mu umamupe nagirewa nop muga anu taiwanian amba mu den intum tan, God ayamase taiwanian.
Apan yampo Stepanas ge Potunatas ge Akaikas inanap tauane menan aton anun. E yaman oare waniana menan e garewa ega mu yampo di.
E imuya vetureni mini, mu tauane gapan imuna veturen. Menan waenapan ta warit muga map anegawa iramu yao wa atonat mumapen iwa mu anu tumat muga kakae di.

God waenapan mega at Eisia nagirewa gaun inayap waiwanum. Apan Akwila waenewa Pirisela dere Iesu dugup mega pa muga gapan iamine nagirewa den, iravi Ayop Iesu men daiton tayana gapan, gaun baware inayap waiwanum.
Mapa Iesu dugup mega nagirewa iragi gaun kaewa inayap waiwanum. Gare gare gaun tan, nonup gapan ua ton.
Endi ne Pol ok ma nek naninap siangin.
Waenapan da da imu pose Ayop nuga Iesu inap ya warepi, God nemoro mega yavep. Maranata wapen, ame ian Gurik nop muga gapan. Gueguewa ame, Ayop nuga Iesu onak.
Ayop nuga Iesu wat aipakam mega garaetawa inayap wande ep.
Enan anu gurina menan anu gurat nega Iesu yaua gapan inayap wande ep.
